name: Education
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of education as rooted in the fear of the LORD, which is described as the beginning of both knowledge and wisdom (Proverbs 1:7; 9:10). Instruction is to be diligently pursued and cherished, as it sustains life and leads to greater understanding (Proverbs 4:13; 9:9). Parents bear responsibility to teach their children consistently in daily life (Deuteronomy 11:19), highlighting the importance of Christian education in the home. Wisdom and understanding are portrayed as more valuable than earthly riches, underscoring the eternal significance of godly learning (Proverbs 16:16).
